mapper.insert: INSERT INTO worker_profiles (worker_id, name, phone, avatar_url, skills, available_days, gender, birthday, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workerId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{avatarUrl}, #{skills}, #{availableDays}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_id, name, phone, avatar_url, skills, available_days, gender, birthday, created_at, updated_at FROM worker_profiles WHERE worker_id = #{workerId}
